title: OnlyPics
tagline: Social Network made by humans, to humans. We believe in human interactions and a little bit on fun in the bidding of pictures.
description: Only Pics is a platform for people that wants to share with the world pictures and for people that believes on the value of those moments, where both sides can get something of value either by investing on those images and seeing them grow and get recognized on the web, or by managing to share your favorite moment.
how_its_made:
This project user Typescript + Vite + Tailwind css to build the frontend, also a nodeJS integration with firebase for backend and smart contracts using the HeartBitSDK. Also we have a notable use of a social network
